summary.interpretation: Confidence interval unavailable: each represented scenario needs at least two complete pairs. Small samples cannot establish equivalence.

retry_policy: One complete pair retried after a clock-alignment failure before audio input. Original failed run and unmatched partner retained. Both retry modes use the same bounded five-second clock wait. Retry order shuffled with seed 101; no latency-based retries.

provenance.environment: Windows, Python 3.12, local worker and receiver, LiveKit Cloud India South
provenance.notes: Synthetic fixed speech fixtures; first pair is excluded warmup. No simultaneous microphone demo or other replay load during collection. This is a shared development laptop, not an isolated performance host; brief test and browser activity occurred during collection. Input pacing is checked, but CPU and network contention remain confounders.

retry_outcome: Both retry arms timed out waiting for readiness while the local worker was unavailable. Worker restarted afterward; no further latency-based retries.
configuration_note: Historical configuration: measured before the Windows audio workaround (24 kHz input and cloud recording enabled). Current worker uses 16 kHz input and no cloud recording; see the separate smoke checks.
